# War Scroll Column 12 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 12 | **Condition:** complete

---

**12:1** Blessed be the-God of-Israel who-keeps covenant-faithfulness with-His-covenant and-appointed-times of-salvation for-the-people He-redeems. He-has-called those-who-stumble

**12:2** to-wonderful mighty-deeds, and-He-has-gathered the-assembly of-nations for-destruction without-remnant. He-has-raised-up in-judgment

**12:3** the-faint of-heart, and-He-has-opened the-mouth of-the-dumb for-joyful-song. He-has-taught weak-hands to-make-war,

**12:4** and-trembling knees He-has-girded with-strength-of-standing. Through-the-poor in-spirit shall-a-hard-heart be-

**12:5** judged, and-by-the-perfect-of-way all the-wicked nations shall-come-to-an-end. And-all their-mighty-warriors shall-not-stand,

**12:6** for-the-God of-Israel and-the-angel of-His-truth help all the-Sons of-Light. For You-made Belial

**12:7** for-the-pit, an-angel of-enmity; in-darkness is-his-dominion, and-his-counsel is to-bring-about wickedness and-guilt. And-all the-spirits

**12:8** of-his-lot are-angels of-destruction; they-walk in-the-statutes of-darkness, and-toward-it is their-desire as-one. But-we,

**12:9** the-lot of-Your-truth, we-shall-rejoice in-the-hand of-Your-might. We-shall-be-glad in-Your-salvation, and-we-shall-exult

**12:10** in-Your-strength and-in-Your-peace. Who is like-You in-strength, O-God of-Israel? And-with-the-poor-ones is

**12:11** the-hand of-Your-might. And-what angel or-prince is like-the-help of-Your-presence? For You

**12:12** appointed the-day of-battle from-of-old [...] to-help truth and-to-destroy guilt, to-bring-down darkness

**12:13** and-to-strengthen light, and-to-stand-up for [...] an-eternal-standing, and-to-destroy all the-Sons of-Darkness, and-joy

**12:14** for-all the-Sons of-Light. As-the-fire of-His-wrath burns against-the-idols of-Egypt,

**12:15** so-shall-You-act against [...] For-You are the-God of-our-fathers; we-bless Your-name forever.

**12:16** We are the-people of-Your-inheritance; You-made a-covenant with-our-fathers, and-You-shall-establish it for-their-seed

**12:17** through the-appointed-times of-eternity. And-in-all the-appointed-times of-Your-glory there-has-been a-remembrance of-Your-covenant-faithfulness among-us for-a-help to-the-remnant and-the-survivors of-Your-covenant, to-recount Your-deeds of-truth and-the-judgments of-Your-wondrous mighty-deeds.

---

*EMET notes: Column 12 is the hymn after the first engagement. "Covenant-faithfulness" renders hesed per project conventions. Belial named as "angel of enmity" (12:7). The contrast between Sons of Light and Sons of Darkness is central (12:6-14). "Poor in spirit" (12:4) parallels Matthew 5:3. Construct chains hyphenated throughout.*
